recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is recommended for FHIR-12500; restoring the older beginning/ordering wording would conflict with the later clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-12500 was a Published FHIR-I change request resolved Persuasive for DSTU2. It asked for a clarification in the Contained Resources guidance that a contained resource can be placed in any resource inheriting from DomainResource and that the contained element's location should be clear.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn @11163, represented in git as 020d61bce175f562e9da06e38a268357fc76170b, which added a contained-resource bullet to source/references.html. The original application included the DomainResource placement guidance and an order-specific sentence about being after narrative and before extensions.
additional_context: FHIR-40468 later determined that the order-specific part of the FHIR-12500 wording was misleading for JSON and replaced it with child-at-root wording. The combined branch already contains an audit commit for FHIR-40468, so it was treated as related context rather than decided again.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. source/references.html currently says the contained resource can be put in any DomainResource using the contained element as a child element at the root of the resource, which satisfies FHIR-12500 while preserving the later FHIR-40468 JSON-neutral refinement.
